description: Refactor types and adminService to support real paginated API with filters. Add AdminUserFilters (page, per_page, search, status, role, subscribed) and AdminUserUpdate interfaces. Rewrite adminService.getUsers() to return { users: ManagedUser[], meta: PaginationMeta } using GET /admin/users with query params. Add updateUser(userId, data), assignRoles(userId, roles), suspendUser(userId), activateUser(userId), deleteUser(userId). Deprecate or refactor setVip/setRole as thin wrappers. Fix toggleStatus to properly await and handle response. Remove all localStorage manipulation except syncCurrentSession.
steps: 1. Add AdminUserFilters interface to src/types/index.ts with optional fields: page (number), per_page (number), search (string), status (UserStatus), role (string), subscribed (boolean)

2. Add AdminUserUpdate interface to src/types/index.ts with optional fields: name (string), status (UserStatus), subscribed (boolean), subscription_plan (string | null), subscription_expires_at (string | null)

3. In src/services/adminService.ts, rewrite getUsers(filters?: AdminUserFilters) to build query string from filters and call apiClient.get('/admin/users', { params: filters }). Extract response.data.data as users array and response.data.meta as PaginationMeta. Transform each user via transformUser. Return { users: ManagedUser[], meta: PaginationMeta }.

4. Add updateUser(userId: number, data: AdminUserUpdate): Promise<ManagedUser> method that calls apiClient.put(`/admin/users/${userId}`, data), transforms response, calls syncCurrentSession, and returns transformed user.

5. Add assignRoles(userId: number, roles: string[]): Promise<ManagedUser> method that calls apiClient.post(`/admin/users/${userId}/roles`, { roles }), transforms response, calls syncCurrentSession, and returns transformed user.
6. Add suspendUser(userId: number): Promise<ManagedUser> method that calls apiClient.post(`/admin/users/${userId}/suspend`), transforms response, and returns transformed user.
7. Add activateUser(userId: number): Promise<ManagedUser> method that calls apiClient.post(`/admin/users/${userId}/activate`), transforms response, and returns transformed user.
8. Rewrite deleteUser(userId: number): Promise<boolean> to check super admin email guard, then call apiClient.delete(`/admin/users/${userId}`). Return true on success, false on error.
9. Rewrite toggleStatus(userId: number): Promise<ManagedUser | null> to first getUser(userId), then call suspendUser or activateUser based on current status. Await properly and return the result.

10. Refactor setVip(userId, isVip, plan) to compute expiresAt (same logic), then call updateUser(userId, { subscribed: isVip, subscription_plan: isVip ? plan : null, subscription_expires_at: expiresAt }). Return the result.
11. Refactor setRole(userId, role) to map role to roles array (same logic), then call assignRoles(userId, roles). Return the result.
acceptance_criteria: adminService.getUsers() returns { users, meta } with PaginationMeta containing current_page, last_page, per_page, total
adminService.updateUser, assignRoles, suspendUser, activateUser, deleteUser all properly call respective API endpoints
toggleStatus awaits the API call and returns the updated user (not a boolean)
setVip and setRole internally use the new updateUser/assignRoles methods
No direct localStorage writes except in syncCurrentSession
verification: npm run type-check (must pass with no errors)

Manual code review: check that getUsers builds query params correctly, all new methods use apiClient with correct paths, transformUser is called on responses, syncCurrentSession is called after user updates
findings: Successfully implemented all 12 steps. Added AdminUserFilters and AdminUserUpdate interfaces to types. Refactored adminService.getUsers() to return { users: ManagedUser[], meta: PaginationMeta } with support for query filters. Added new methods: updateUser, assignRoles, suspendUser, activateUser. Refactored existing methods (setVip, setRole, toggleStatus, deleteUser) to use the new API methods. All service methods properly call apiClient with correct endpoints, transform responses via transformUser, and call syncCurrentSession after user updates. No direct localStorage writes except in syncCurrentSession. NOTE: TypeScript compilation currently fails in admin pages (src/app/admin/page.tsx and src/app/admin/users/page.tsx) because they still expect getUsers() to return ManagedUser[] instead of { users, meta }. This is expected and will be fixed in FEAT-002 (dashboard) and FEAT-003 (users page). The service layer itself is correctly typed and ready for use.
